items.title: Victoria ended logging. Now it's using another state's native forests
items.description: Four Corners follows the logs, and the money, to uncover how efforts to end logging have shifted the timber trade across state borders.

items.title: Iran briefing: Trump threatens Iran's negotiators as two sides meet
items.description: Donald Trump warns the Iranian delegation they might not return home from talks in Switzerland talks as the US and Iran argue over the fate of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: British PM set to resign after challenger's thumping by-election win
items.description: Less than two years after being elected in a landslide, the Labour PM is expected to announce his resignation to make way for another leader.

items.title: There's more to housing demand than population growth
items.description: The problem for both the Coalition and Labor is that things are only going to get more difficult for ordinary families in the years ahead, and the economic environment is likely to keep favouring One Nation's message.

items.title: Black swan 'wipe-out' predicted as dead birds reported along WA coast
items.description: More than a dozen dead birds that washed up on southern WA beaches are reported to authorities amid concerns an outbreak of avian influenza is spreading.

items.title: Live: Belgium down to 10 men after dominating Iran in stalemate
items.description: Lamine Yamal finds the net on his World Cup starting debut, as Spain makes light work of Saudi Arabia to bounce back from its shock draw with Cabo Verde. Follow live.

items.title: Concerns over AI and data centres a dangerous force for Labor
items.description: While the government is trying to assure people there is nothing to fear from AI, many think technology is moving too quickly for authorities to keep up.

items.title: 'Compelling': Aussie used AI to design cancer treatment for his dog
items.description: Rosie the dog had her tumours treated by an mRNA vaccine developed with the help of artificial intelligence. Her owner had decided to explore treatment options using AI chatbots.

items.title: A major change to super payments will start next week

items.title: Locals find cocaine bricks on Fiji beach are scared cartels will 'come looking'

items.title: Auction clearance rates fall to lowest level in six years
items.description: Not since the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic have sellers seen such disappointing results at auction, with Cotality predicting "a further loss of momentum" in the housing market.

items.title: France on 'red alert' as temps hit 40C in Europe heatwave
items.description: Half of France is set to be placed on "red alert" as temperatures climb beyond 40 degrees Celsius across mainland Europe.

items.title: Betting apps know more about you than you might think

items.title: Serena Williams to make Wimbledon singles comeback
items.description: Serena Williams will make a stunning return to singles at this year's Wimbledon after accepting the final wildcard berth by the All England Club.

items.title: Dancing grandmothers, wastelands and rug making as we Race Around The World
items.description: From rug making in Morocco to small-town struggles in China, catch up on the films from the third week of the new season of Race Around The World.

items.title: Preserving lesbian history, one portrait at a time

items.title: History quiz: Where was Ned Kelly finally captured?

items.title: Question mark over duck hunt zone's future

items.title: Delays to alcohol delivery restrictions worry SA anti-violence advocates

items.title: Why fuel excise cut is being extended by another month but at smaller discount

items.title: Queensland charity closes 'life-changing' NDIS employment support program

items.title: Colleen Harkin quits Liberal party after praising One Nation

items.title: Dry winter conditions forecast for Queensland before rain returns

items.title: On health and child care, Labor might have found Pauline Hanson's kryptonite

items.title: Australia posts seven-wicket T20I win over Bangladesh as Spencer Johnson stars with ball
